head-protection.name: Head Protection

hand-protection.name: Hand Protection

body-protection.name: Body Protection

welding-safety.name: Welding Safety Equipment

fall-protection.name: Fall Protection
fall-protection.short: Full body and climbing harnesses, rescue and window cleaning kits, lifelines and 3M DBI-SALA systems.

fall-arresters-ladders.name: Fall Arresters & Ladders
fall-arresters-ladders.short: Fall arresters, tripods, descenders, safety and shade nets, and FRP, aluminium and roof-top ladders.

fire-extinguishers.name: Fire Extinguishers
fire-extinguishers.short: Water-CO2, mechanical foam, ABC, CO2 and clean agent fire extinguishers.

emergency-rescue.name: Emergency Rescue Equipment

first-aid.name: First Aid Equipment
first-aid.short: First aid boxes, stretchers, spine boards, rescue hoods, blankets, oxygen and resuscitation equipment.

eyewash-shower.name: Eyewash & Shower

sorbents-spill-kits.name: Sorbents — Oil & Chemical Spill Kits

safety-cans-cabinets.name: Safety Cans & Cabinets
safety-cans-cabinets.short: Safety cans, storage cans, safety cabinets, spill pallets, drum trolleys and containment caddies.

gas-detection.name: Gas Detectors & Instruments
gas-detection.short: RIKEN KEIKI gas detectors, fixed gas monitoring, and noise, temperature, wind and light meters.

safe-lighting.name: Intrinsically Safe Lighting
safe-lighting.short: Wolf and Pelican torches, remote area lighting and helmet-mounted head lamps.

traffic-safety.name: Traffic Safety Equipment
traffic-safety.short: Cones, barriers, road studs, posts, mirrors, metal detectors, tapes, speed bumps and more.

safety-signage.name: Signages
safety-signage.short: Auto-glow signs and tape, vinyl stickers and boards, emergency lights and ERP boards.

electrical-safety.name: Electrical Safety Protection
electrical-safety.short: Electrical gloves, arc flash suits and shields, dielectric boots, insulating ladders, tools and mats.

lockout-tagout.name: Lockout / Tagout
